title: Relay settings connection feedback and late NIP-07 signer detection

observed_behavior.relay_settings: Saving relay changes did not confirm which relays actually connected, and new relays could remain visually ambiguous until a socket opened or failed.
observed_behavior.nip07_auth: If window.nostr appeared after initial bootstrap, the UI stayed stuck in a no-extension state and continued showing the missing-signer warning.

intended_behavior.relay_settings: Saving relay settings should expose connecting/connected state and report how many configured relays successfully connected.
intended_behavior.nip07_auth: The auth UI should react when a signer appears after startup and clear stale missing-signer warnings once a signer is available.
